collection_notes:
UNITS - IMPORTANT: the per-hole lengths above are METERS, not yards. Proof: the Champion column sums to 6,657; converting each hole to yards (/0.9144) and rounding gives exactly 7,281 yards, which is the club's published tips total from three independent sources. Individually, All Square's hole 12 = 491 m = 537.0 yd, matching Texas Outside's description of #12 as 'a 537 yard par 5 from the tips' exactly. The Mens column (6,223 m) converts to ~6,806 yd against a published Blue of 6,813 yd (within per-hole rounding drift), so Mens = Blue. Senior (5,611 m ~ 6,136 yd) and Ladies (5,015 m ~ 5,484 yd) do NOT cleanly map to the published White 6,323 yd and Red 5,522 yd, so no ratings were attached to them. I did not convert the lengths to yards myself - that would have been reconstruction, and every hole would be off by up to a yard.

HOLE ORDERING: All Square, GolfPass and Hole19 all carry the same 18 numbers but two of them present the nines in opposite order.
